results.note: De consona tonorum diversitate by Berno of Reichenau (d. 1048). No English translation found; exists in Latin in Migne PL 142 and medieval music theory collections.
De rebus pertinentibus ad missae officium (On matters pertaining to the Mass office). No English translation found in available sources.
De varia modulatione psalmorum by Berno; medieval music theory treatise. Latin text in Migne PL 142; no complete English translation located.
Dialogus by Berno. No English translation found in available sources or databases.
Epistolae by Berno of Reichenau. No English translation located despite targeted searches.
Fragmenta epistolarum by Berno. No English translation found.
Monitum by Berno. No English translation found.

Musica (or Prologus in tonarium) by Berno of Reichenau. English translation by Edward Nowacki in 'Greek and Latin Music Theory: Principles and Challenges' (Boydell & Brewer, 2020), Chapter 13, pp. 131-148.
Ratio generalis de initio adventus Domini by Berno. No English translation found.
Versus by Berno (29 words). No English translation located; very brief text.
Vita S. Meginradi by Berno. German translation exists (Dietrich Blume, 2008) but no English translation found.
Vita S. Udalrici by Berno. German translation by Dietrich Blume (Ostfildern, 2008); no English translation located.
Liber qualiter adventus Domini celebretur by Berno (PL 150, 1079B-1086B). No English translation found.
De contritione cordis, attributed to Auctor incertus (Anselmus Cantuariensis?). Work with uncertain authorship; no English translation found.

Meditationes, attributed to uncertain author or Anselm. Though Anselm's own Meditationes have English translations via CCEL, this specific work attributed to Auctor incertus has no confirmed English translation.
De cognitione verae vitae, attributed to uncertain author (possibly Honorius Augustodunensis or Anselm). No English translation found despite searches.

De conceptione S. Mariae, attributed to Auctor incertus (Anselmus Cantuariensis?), PL 159:323B-326A. Possibly related to or confused with Eadmer's treatise on same subject (5612), which has Thurston & Slater edition (1904). Requires clarification whether this is distinct work.
De stabilitate monachi, attributed to Auctor incertus. No English translation found.
Dialogus B. Mariae et Anselmi de passione Domini, attributed to Pseudo-Anselm. English translation by William Darker of Sheen exists in Bodleian Library MS. Laud Misc. 38. Scholarly access only.
Liber de mensuratione crucis, attributed to Pseudo-Anselm (PL 159:289B-302B). No English translation found in available sources.
Miraculum S. Jacobi (PL 159:335B-338A). No English translation found.
Miraculum grande S. Jacobi (PL 159:337B-340D). No English translation found.
Passio SS. Guineri Fingaris Pialae et sociorum (PL 159:325B-334C). Medieval hagiographic text; no English translation found.
Sermo de conceptione B. Mariae, attributed to uncertain author (PL 159:319A-324A). No English translation found despite searches.
Tractatus de conceptione B. Mariae by Eadmer (PL 159:301C-318D). English edition by H. Thurston & T. Slater published Freiburg im Breisgau, 1904. Scholarly/institutional access.
Vita S. Anselmi by Eadmer of Canterbury. English translation by R. W. Southern in Oxford Medieval Texts series (Nelson, 1962, bilingual Latin-English). Commercially published.
De S. Anselmi similitudinibus by Eadmer (PL 159:605B-708D). No English translation found in available sources.

De beatitudine coelestis patriae. Eadmer recorded Anselm's text. English translation titled 'The Glories of Heaven' by Fr. Robert Nixon, OSB (TAN Direction) exists, but unclear if this is Eadmer's own work or direct Anselm text. Ambiguous attribution.
De quatuor virtutibus B. Mariae by Eadmer (PL 159:580D-586D). No English translation found.

Epistola ad Glastonienses by Eadmer. English translation by Richard Sharpe: 'Eadmer's letter to the monks of Glastonbury concerning St Dunstan's disputed remains' in 'The archaeology and history of Glastonbury abbey' (1991), pp. 208-15.
Epistola ad monachos Wigornienses by Eadmer (PL 159:807B-808C). No English translation found.
Historia novorum by Eadmer of Canterbury. English translation by Geoffrey Bosanquet (Cresset Press, 1964; reprinted Dufour, Philadelphia, 1965). Foreword by R. W. Southern. Commercially published.
Liber de excellentia Virginis Mariae by Eadmer (PL 159:557D-580C). No standalone English translation found, though work influenced medieval English translations.
Vita Bregwini by Eadmer. Edited by B. W. Scholz in Traditio 22 (1966): 127-48 but no English translation located.

Vita Dunstani by Eadmer. English translation (Latin-English facing text) in 'Eadmer of Canterbury: Lives and Miracles of Saints Oda, Dunstan, and Oswald' ed. Turner & Muir (Oxford Medieval Texts, 2006).

Vita Oswaldi by Eadmer. English translation (Latin-English facing text) in 'Eadmer of Canterbury: Lives and Miracles of Saints Oda, Dunstan, and Oswald' ed. Turner & Muir (Oxford Medieval Texts, Clarendon Press, 2006).

Vita Wilfridi by Eadmer (PL 159:709A-752D). English translation in Oxford Medieval Texts edition ed. Turner & Muir (2006) and/or Exeter University Press edition (1998) with B. J. Muir and A. J. Turner.
